## Meaning

This monitor fired because a fixed threshold was crossed.

Query:

```
min(last_30m):sum:kubernetes_state.hpa.current_replicas{__SCOPE__} by {kube_cluster_name,kube_namespace,hpa} - sum:kubernetes_state.hpa.max_replicas{__SCOPE__} by {kube_cluster_name,kube_namespace,hpa} >= 0
```

**Why this threshold is a fixed number.** "At max replicas" is a configured ceiling — the autoscaler has run out of the room it was given and cannot absorb more load.

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-k8s-workload-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `auto-capacity-ticket` (fully automatic) runs when triggered.

Actions: `attach_forecast_chart`, `create_servicenow_task`, `assign_to_owner`.
